description: This file defines a class 'DashboardsTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages dashboard table settings, actions, and interactions within an Angular application, including CRUD operations, navigation, and dialog handling for dashboards.

classes.name: DashboardsTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular service class that configures dashboard table behavior, including data loading, actions, and navigation within the application.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and configures the dashboard table based on route parameters and user authority, setting up columns, actions, and permissions.

methods.name: configureColumns
methods.description: Defines table columns based on dashboard scope (tenant, edge, customer).

methods.name: configureEntityFunctions
methods.description: Sets fetch and delete functions for dashboards depending on scope.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Defines actions available on each dashboard cell, such as export, publish, and manage customers.

methods.name: configureGroupActions
methods.description: Defines bulk actions for dashboards, like assign/unassign to customers or edges.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Defines actions for adding or importing dashboards.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Navigates to the dashboard detail view based on scope.

methods.name: importDashboard
methods.description: Initiates dashboard import process.

methods.name: editMissingAliases
methods.description: Opens dialog to resolve missing entity aliases during dashboard import.

methods.name: exportDashboard
methods.description: Exports a dashboard by ID.

methods.name: importDashboardFile
methods.description: Opens dialog to import dashboard from file.

methods.name: addDashboardsToCustomer
methods.description: Opens dialog to add dashboards to a customer.

methods.name: makePublic
methods.description: Makes a dashboard public.

methods.name: makePrivate
methods.description: Makes a dashboard private.

methods.name: manageAssignedCustomers
methods.description: Opens dialog to manage customers assigned to a dashboard.

methods.name: assignDashboardsToCustomers
methods.description: Assigns dashboards to customers.

methods.name: unassignDashboardsFromCustomers
methods.description: Unassigns dashboards from customers.

methods.name: showManageAssignedCustomersDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog for managing dashboard-customer assignments.

methods.name: unassignFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns a dashboard from a specific customer.

methods.name: unassignDashboardsFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns multiple dashboards from a customer.

methods.name: onDashboardAction
methods.description: Handles various dashboard actions triggered from UI.

methods.name: addDashboardsToEdge
methods.description: Opens dialog to add dashboards to an edge.

methods.name: unassignFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns a dashboard from an edge.

methods.name: unassignDashboardsFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns multiple dashboards from an edge.

methods.name: saveAndAssignDashboard
methods.description: Saves a new dashboard and assigns it to customers if specified.
